name: Medium-voltage distribution (11 kV and 33 kV)
principle: Malaysia's MV distribution levels: TNB supplies 11 kV for roughly 1,000-5,000 kVA and 33 kV up to about 25,000 kVA (22 kV appears in parts of Johor and Perak). At site level an intake substation receives the supply and ring-main units feed substation transformers, often with redundant transformers and an N+1 scheme for critical process loads. MV installations carry the highest periodic-inspection frequency under the Electricity Regulations.
